description: PD-aware SGLang dashboard for DCE5/CubeStack. Adds prompt/generation/cached token throughput, KV/token usage, absolute used-token gauges, and dedicated prefill/decode PD queue metrics.

panels.title: Prompt Tokens / s
panels.description: Prompt-token throughput counted on the prefill side.

panels.title: Generation Tokens / s
panels.description: Generated-token throughput counted on the decode side.

panels.title: Prefill KV Usage
panels.description: SGLang token_usage is a 0-1 memory-pool/KV token usage ratio.

panels.title: Max Decode KV Usage
panels.description: Maximum KV/token-pool usage among selected decode ranks.

panels.title: Decode Used Tokens
panels.description: Used tokens summed once per decode DP rank.

panels.title: Cached Tokens / s
panels.description: Prompt tokens served from prefix cache, counted on prefill.

panels.title: KV / Token Usage by Role
panels.description: KV/token-pool utilization ratio. Decode shows the most loaded DP rank.

panels.title: Prefill PD Queues
panels.description: Bootstrap queue: requests waiting for PD bootstrap; inflight queue: prefill requests currently in the PD handoff pipeline.

panels.title: Decode PD Queues
panels.description: Decode-side queueing before KV preallocation and during KV transfer.
